title: Dispatch: preserve item state timers on non-restating re-entry (attempt 1)
description:
Implementation dispatch for eshyra-jw56. Read `bd show eshyra-jw56` first — its
notes carry the design decision, the source-backed curation table, and the
acceptance criteria. This bead carries the pre-planning survey.

Worktree: `.worktrees/<this-bead-id>`, branch `<this-bead-id>`, cut from branch
`eshyra-jw56`. Work only inside that worktree.

## Code survey (already done — trust it, but verify before editing)

- `packages/core/src/state/itemTimers.ts` (128 lines): `resolveItemStateTimers`
  (anchors declarations to the campaign clock, rolls dice-defined durations) and
  `reconcileItemStateTimers(transitionTo, resolved)` (drops timers not owned by
  the entered state; the doc comment there states the current wrong assumption
  "re-entering a state replaces its prior deadline" — update it).
  Not exported from `src/index.ts` or `src/internal.ts`, so its signature is
  free to change. Callers: `itemState.ts:1848`, `itemResetExecutor.ts:839`.
- `packages/core/src/state/itemState.ts`:
  - `selectStateTransition` (~1285-1420) picks the transition and, at ~1392,
    collects the entered state's timer declarations into
    `result.pendingTimers`.
  - ~1837-1859 resolves them; ~2061 calls `reconcileItemStateTimers` and writes
    `pendingTimers` into the persisted state.
  - `state?.machineState` and `state?.pendingTimers` are both in scope at 1846.
  - `validateItemStateForRecord` (~461-519) validates persisted timer shape —
    unchanged by this work; preserved timers already satisfy the
    `deadline === anchor + amount * multiplier` invariant.
- `packages/core/src/rules/magicItemMechanics.ts`: `MagicItemStateMachine`
  transition type at ~96-110; validation at ~864-914 with the
  `only(transition, ['from','to','via','timer','condition','effects','onFailure','note'])`
  allowlist and the "exactly one of via, timer, or condition" rule.
- Generated pack scan found exactly three machines with a `via` self-transition
  on a timer-bearing state: records.json indices 813 (Bead of Force),
  841 (Cube of Force), 959 (Ring of Shooting Stars) — 12 transitions total.
  All three are curated in
  `packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemComplexStateMachines.ts`
  (Bead of Force ~line 108-140, Cube of Force ~line 261-306, Ring of Shooting
  Stars ~line 588-615).

## Plan

1. **Schema** (`magicItemMechanics.ts`): add `readonly resetsDuration?: true` to
   the transition type; add `'resetsDuration'` to the `only()` allowlist;
   validate that the value is exactly boolean `true` and that the transition has
   `from === to` — a `RulesPackError` otherwise, with the path in the message.
   Consider also rejecting the marker when the entered state declares no timer
   (no transition with `from === <state>` and a `timer`), which catches dead
   markers; do it if it stays simple.
2. **Timers** (`itemTimers.ts`): let `resolveItemStateTimers` reuse already-
   pending timers. Preferred shape — replace the trailing positional
   `anchorElapsedMinutes` with an options bag
   `{ anchorElapsedMinutes?: number; preserved?: readonly ItemStateTimer[] }`
   and update the `itemResetExecutor.ts:839` call plus `itemTimers.test.ts`.
   For each declaration, if `preserved` holds an entry with matching `from` and
   `to`, return it verbatim (no clock read, **no dice roll** — a dice-defined
   timer must not be re-rolled); otherwise resolve fresh. Map over declarations
   so output order stays declaration order. Fix the stale doc comment on
   `reconcileItemStateTimers`.
3. **Engine** (`itemState.ts`): surface `resetsDuration` on
   `SelectedStateTransition` from `selectStateTransition`; at the resolve site
   pass `preserved: state?.pendingTimers ?? []` when
   `selectedTransition.nextState === state?.machineState && !resetsDuration`,
   and `[]` otherwise. Do not change `reconcileItemStateTimers`'s ownership
   check — preserved timers already carry `from === nextState`.
4. **Curation** (`magicItemComplexStateMachines.ts`): add
   `resetsDuration: true` to the five Cube of Force `press-face-N` transitions
   whose `from === to`, with a short source note in the existing comment style.
   Leave `spell-contact-loss`, `move-force-sphere`, and `move-ball-lightning`
   unmarked. Do not hand-edit `records.json`.
5. **Regenerate**: `npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1`
   (confirm the flag against `packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/cli.ts`
   before running), then `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack`. The generated diff must
   be confined to the Cube of Force machine (5 transitions gain the key). Any
   other churn: stop and report in your completion notes.
6. **Tests**:
   - `packages/core/test/itemTimers.test.ts` — preserved timers keep anchor,
     deadline and `roll`; unmatched declarations still resolve fresh; assert no
     RNG consumption for preserved dice timers (an `Rng` whose `nextInt` throws).
     The existing "replaces all stale timers when a state is entered or left"
     test encodes the old assumption; update it deliberately and say in your
     notes whether the regression contract is preserved or replaced.
   - `packages/core/test/itemState.test.ts` — end-to-end on a fixture pack:
     enter a timed state at t=0, advance the clock, self-transition without the
     marker → deadline unchanged; with the marker → re-anchored; cross-state
     transition → fresh anchor.
   - `packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemComplexStateMachines.test.ts`
     — assert the four curation rulings from the parent bead's table.
   - a schema test for the new validation rules (see
     `magicItemMechanics`-related tests under `packages/core/test/`).
   - `packages/core/test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts` may hold baselines that need
     updating — check.
7. **Docs**: `docs/item-reset-executor.md` §"Timers and fail-closed behavior"
   describes the cancel/replace semantics; add the re-entry rule and the
   `resetsDuration` marker there.

## Constraints

- `docs/importer-fix-protocol.md` governs steps 4-6: no hand-edited generated
  records, no weakened audit expectations, and your completion note must report
  affected record IDs, the generated diff, and why each change is expected.
- Do NOT touch `docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/freeze-manifest.json`. Its

  tracked by eshyra-o9bd.14).
- `npm run verify:worktree` **before** committing (it rewrites files). Commit on
  your branch. Do not push, do not open a PR, do not merge — integration is the
  dispatching agent's job. Never modify eshyra-jw56.

Node 24, `npm ci` if the worktree needs an install. The importer runs via `tsx`.
Full suite is slow; run focused vitest files while iterating, then the full
`npm run verify:worktree` once.

- Engine preserves timers only for same-state transitions without resetsDuration; cross-state and marked transitions resolve fresh.

Affected generated record: magic-item:cube-of-force only. Generated diff: five self-transitions (face-1..face-5 press-face-N) gained resetsDuration: true; no Bead of Force, Cube spell-contact-loss, or Ring of Shooting Stars transitions changed. This is expected because the SRD says pressing a different face resets duration, while spell contact and movement preserve the duration; the marker explicitly represents the reset action.
